head: cb12f370feb558002c7416ffe0087a9814e1b091
limitations: Native CLI stdout/stderr and app-server stdout/stderr are preserved verbatim.
HTTP bodies/headers are represented by native identity, SHA256, terminal and fault metadata; complete raw HTTP wire bytes were not recorded.
App-server stdin RPC write bytes were not separately recorded; exact frozen script, actual IDs, prompts and child arguments are retained.
Uses isolated custom provider and real production adapter with only worker.run substituted. No real browser/model or built-in-provider installation acceptance.
